LESSON: COOKING FOOD • BOILING FOOD • SHALLOW FRYING FOOD

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.5: Cooking Food • Boiling food • Shallow frying food
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 11

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cooking Food • Boiling food • Shallow frying food, part of Food Production Processes in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: where videos are not captioned. How can we cook food using boiling and shallow frying methods?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cooking Food • Boiling food • Shallow frying food together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility: observes safety precautions when boiling and shallow frying food.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety of self and others to avoid accidents as they boil and fry food.

Link to other subjects:

Learners relate handling of accidents to skills learnt from first aid in Science and Technology.
